name: ndi-social
description: NDI's Social Media Manager plugins for Claude Code and Cowork, installable straight from this repo.

plugins.name: instagram-manager
plugins.description: Manage an Instagram Business or Creator account end to end through Composio: publishing, insights, comments, and direct messages.

plugins.name: x-manager
plugins.description: Manage an X (Twitter) account through Composio: posting and threads, engagement, search and monitoring, lists, DMs and analytics.

plugins.name: youtube-manager
plugins.description: Manage a YouTube channel through Composio: uploads, metadata, playlists, comments, transcripts and analytics, with transcript-driven AI workflows.
